messages:
alexa_cs: Heads up: onboarding for SolaraPay—frontend load causes massive preflight fanout; they're getting 429s during SDK init. Sample: 
``n2026-02-10T11:05:01Z preflight id=aa1 status=429 retry_after=20
2026-02-10T11:05:02Z preflight id=aa2 status=429 retry_after=20
```

alexa_cs: They spin ~100 tabs/workers on launch (feature tour). Need quick mitigation steps to unblock them.

reza_infra: Quick fixes: 1) client-side splay + jitter on init; 2) use single shared token cache in the page; 3) cap concurrent preflights to ~8; 4) we can apply a short burst quota while they warm up.

tom_devex: Snippet to cache token and limit refreshers: `let token=null; let exp=0; async function getToken(){ if(token && Date.now()<exp-5000) return token; /* fetch and set token, exp */ }` and ensure only N workers refresh via semaphore.

alexa_cs: Security might object to TTL changes. Can we offer token-proxy approach?

reza_infra: Yes—recommend tiny edge proxy that caches ephemeral tokens for 30-60s. That keeps client behavior unchanged and prevents stampede. Also we can temporarily bump burst quota +30% for 1 hour if they need breathing room.

ops-bot: Applied quota change for account_solarapay: +30% burst for 1 hour (ticket=SOL-20260210-01).

(4m later)

reza_infra: Devs patched page to reuse token and added splay; preflight 429s dropped from ~25% to <1%. Logs now mostly 200s.

alexa_cs: Great. I'll schedule a 15-min enablement to walk them through production guidance: proxy pattern, TTL policy, keep-alive to reuse connections.

tom_devex: I'll add a short note to browser SDK docs about onboarding warmups and include both token-cache and proxy options.

reza_infra: Confirming stable for 15m. Closing from infra side. :thumbsup:
